reviews.text: Outstanding collar. It looks stunning on my girl. As special as she is. Pre sales services was excellent with advice in sizing from Elaine. If you want a stand out collar you won’t be disappointed
Thank you very much Katie.  Dont know what we did 😂 but hooray that we made you happy!! …

Wanted to visit this shop for ages but usually shut when I've walked past.
This time it was open. I saw there was an assistant inside and went to go in but the door was locked. No problem there as many shops today do this.
So, I knocked. The assistant looked directly at me with a sour face and didn't respond. Even if she couldn't get to the door surely some acknowledgement?
Obviously don't need customers like me so they won't get my custom nor from anyone I know.
Cute little store with lots of fun stuff.
Quite tired of stating my preferences which are not listened to so going to go elsewhere.
I love their collars ... absolutely beautiful and well worth the price tag as they last for years. I know as I've been buying them for over 10 years now xxx

OMG. Her new posh fancy charmed collar has just arrived and it’s beautiful. Not just well made but Top Notch well made. You girls are the very best. You sourced these charms for me and made this designer collar in record time. I love you guys. Thank you ver very much from Maori and Star xxx 💕 …

Took my dog (briard) there for grooming today!! She came out looking bloody amazing!! Staff was super friendly and knowledgeable!! Can't recommend this place enough!! Thank you guys we will be back xxx

That's very sad will you tell us why? We are a tiny company doing our very best.  We would love to know what we did to upset you so we have a right to reply.  We had no groomers yesterday nor sold a collar so what did we do... Or not do?

Although our 6 year old H&L collars were still going strong, we thought on the arrival of Charlie, we would treat our dogs to new half chains, in their own special colours! How beautifully crafted these collars are. Thank you
Whoohoo... Looks like you enjoyed your visit.  Thank you for the stars!

Such friendly groomers and do a great job cutting Jamie. She's so comfortable, she falls asleep on the table! There are always other dogs for her to play with, and she can stay a bit longer if I'm running late to pick her up, it's never an issue. They also have a great selection of treats, toys and clothes. I go in all the time, even when J doesn't have a groom booked - just to say hi!

Met a friendly puppy name Sophie during an evening walk in Bedford, Nova Scotia,  Canada. Absolutely adorable k9 wearing a remarkably flashy (but tasteful) blinged out collar.
The pup-parent explained to us where the collar was designed and created.. I had to take a moment to leave a review to make note of how appealing to the eye the piece was BUT ALSO how well it has kept with shine and definition.. the collar was purchased a handful of years ago and worn regularly...

If I had the need/want for an item such as this- I wpuld make the effort to aquire something unique from Holly&Lil.

I’m a little embarrassed to say I am slightly addicted to Holly & Lil collars and I have quite a collection. The only problem is they last too long!!
Beautifully made, beautifully soft, and they look stunning. Very very hard wearing even for dogs who roll. They clean up perfectly………..I’d give six stars if I could!!
Amazing collars!! You will never find another of this quality and standard anywhere!! My two dogs get compliments everywhere we go beautifully made and look stunning!!

I've been to London again in 2023 and went off the boat at Tower Bridge to visit the store with my 2 dogs a Chihuahua named Holly-Hope & and a Jack-Russell-Terrier called Ayla. We live in the North of Germany and we had already a few collar's at home.
They are so unique and special, so the highlight of our trip to UK last year was to visit this store in person! Not only they create so precious collars, they are always friendly and try to help if you have questions or need a size between 2 of what's in the shop. They make collar's for you also when they are out of stock.
They always give their best to make your and your dogs dreams come true.
I can't thank them enough - so if you are searching for something special made with love, check out the homepage or the store in person - take your dog(s) with you... It's a highlight!
When they ship out items they are packed also very carefully.
Sending much love from Ostfriesland/Germany to London/UK!

Do not take your dog here unless you want them to develop an ultimate fear of being groomed… Fully expecting a defensive reply instead of an apology for the aggressive and negative treatment that the pups receive. It’s taken me years to get my dog comfortable with being groomed again. Side note: I watched as a dog was dragged by the scruff of its neck back into the grooming area because they hadn’t finished with “it”. It’s no wonder my dog was shaking everytime I took him there, *thinking* they had his best interests at heart. Avoid at all costs. *I won’t be able to reply to the extensive and defensive reply that might be added in response to this comment… but over multiple visits it became clear that this is a grooming machine that little care for the wellbeing of the babies that we love so dearly. Am lucky to have found another incredible groomer elsewhere.

Very very happy after taking Simba for a first time grooming session at Holly&Lil!  Chelsea's expertise and passion clearly shines through. Simba's coat is now gleaming, and the attention to detail is impeccable. The care and love shown by Chelsea has made it my new go-to place for grooming services moving forwards! Simba is one happy pup, and I couldn't be more pleased with the fantastic job.

I’ve been taking my chihuahuas to Holly and Lil for years for snacks, a natter or a groom. Everyone is so lovely. One time I needed the hospital and my doggy was looked after over night as it was an emergency. Super grateful to have these guys around!

This is my favorite grooming spot in London. The team is super professional and they truly love dogs. My dog is the happiest when he can stay over during the day for a good doggie day play with other dogs. Also, their collar and harnesses and a different level of quality and extremely fashionable. 😎😍 …
